newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Feb vehicle sales fall to 185,610 units.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Feb vehicle sales fall to 185,610 units.

text.p: South Korea's vehicle sales in February dropped to 185,610 units from 194,800 units a year earlier, the Korea Automobile Manufacturers' Association said on Wednesday.
The association said the slowing economy dampened domestic sales, while the Japanese yen's fall against the dollar hit exports.
Domestic vehicle sales in February totalled 105,990 units, down 3.9 percent from 110,236 units a year before, and exports fell 5.8 percent to 79,620 units from 84,564, the association said.
It said a rise in petrol prices also affected February vehicle sales.
"Consumers seem to be delaying their car purchases because of the debut of new models," said an association official.
Hyundai's new minivan, Starex, began to roll out from March and the sub-compact MX car, which will compete with Daewoo Motor's Tico, will hit the road in the second half of 1997.
Kia Motors will begin marketing luxury Enterprise sedans in March and an upgrade of its compact sedan Sephia in June.
Daewoo Motor started selling Nubira compact cars from February and planned to introduce a larger-sized Leganza sedan in April.
The association said vehicle production in February rose to 218,200 units from 208,332 units a year earlier.
